title: Super Cup ATTP – Spring 2024: children
excerpt: Results of the tournament’s children’s categories
body_html:
Three days of high-quality matches at the national table tennis tournament Super Cup ATTP – Spring 2024 🏆 have come to an end — an adrenaline-filled race, with finals that were the most demanding of all for fans of this wonderful sport!

The grandest and most valuable national competition of the domestic spring table tennis cycle, organised by the National Sports Association ATTP at the Top Cup Academy sports complex (Chișinău) with the support and contribution of TOP CUP and SETKA-Pro Moldova, brought together more than 250 table tennis enthusiasts from across the country.

In the under-18 age categories⭐️, the following brave young players stood out on the second day of the championship:

Under-11 category (boys)
🥇1st place – Denis FONARIUC (Ungheni / coach M. Adam)
🥈2nd place – Alexandru MIȚIC (Sângerei / coach R. Mițic)
🥉3rd place – David LIUTENCO (Chișinău / coach N. Smirnova)

Under-11 category (girls)
🥇1st place – Andreea PROHOROVICI (Strășeni / coach N. Prohorovici)
🥈2nd place – Lina VELEȘCU (Călărași / coach A. Radu)
🥉3rd place – Xenia ZUEV (Râbnița / coach A. Zuev)

Cadets / 12-15 (boys)
🥇1st place – Veaceslav LEU (Chișinău)
🥈2nd place – Vlad PROHOROVICI (Strășeni / coach N. Prohorovici)
🥉3rd place – Daniel GÎRBU (Chișinău / I. Ni)

Cadets / 12-15 (girls)
🥇1st place – Camelia LIPOVAN (Strășeni / coach N. Prohorovici)
🥈2nd place – Alina SÎRBU (Strășeni / coach N. Prohorovici)
🥉3rd place – Lavinia SPIVACENCO (Chișinău / coach N. Smirnova)

Juniors / 16-18 (boys)
🥇1st place – Gabriel SPIVACENCO (Chișinău / coach N. Smirnova)
🥈2nd place – Nichita MANDATARI (Chișinău / M. Adam)
🥉3rd place – Leo ROTARI (Chișinău / coach N. Smirnova)

Juniors / 16-18 (girls)
🥇1st place – Bianca BOSTAN (Chișinău / coach A. Yavorsky)
🥈2nd place – Anastasia YAVORSKAYA (Chișinău / coach A. Yavorsky)
🥉3rd place – Polina TITOVA (Chișinău / coach I. Ni)

Congratulations to the players, team members and coaches who contributed to these achievements with their outstanding results.
